findings.cause: Entrance animation driven by IntersectionObserver with opacity 0 as the resting state and no non-JS / no-scroll / reduced-motion fallback. Violates the standing rule that motion never gates content.
findings.evidence: BEFORE scroll probe: opacity '0', transform matrix(1,0,0,1,0,16). AFTER scrollIntoView + 1.8s: opacity '1'. zoom-services.png is blank; viewport-services-scrolled.png shows the cards rendered correctly.
findings.location: section h2='Services' > div.grid > article.fyd-card[data-motion='enter'] (all 5 cards); same pattern on any [data-motion='enter'] section
findings.what: Motion gates content. The 5 service cards sit at computed opacity 0 with translateY(16px) and animation 'fyd-enter running' until scrolled into view. A full-page capture (and print, crawlers, no-scroll contexts) shows a blank 613px Services section.

findings.cause: Pill uses the light-theme provenance text color on the dark hero slab; no dark-variant of the provenance pill.
findings.evidence: zoom-hero.png; forensics.json heroPill: text 'SITE RECORD', color rgb(67,46,45), transparent bg, 1px rgb(205,196,181) border.
findings.location: hero section, eyebrow pill above h1
findings.what: The hero eyebrow pill reads 'SITE RECORD' in 11px rgb(67,46,45) on the dark navy hero background: near-zero contrast, illegible. At 1440 it photographs as an empty pill.

findings.cause: Generator binds the same business description field to both Hero and BusinessSummary with no differentiation pass.
findings.location: hero subcopy vs 'About Happy Place Carpentry LLC' section body
findings.what: Hero subcopy and the About section body are near-verbatim duplicates ('Licensed Oregon carpentry contractor (CCB# 254240) building decks, fences, pergolas, bathrooms, and custom work across Benton, Linn, Marion & Polk Counties.'). Two consecutive sections say the same thing.

findings.cause: No media acquired for this site (manifest empty); renderer has no designed no-media hero treatment, so the fallback is an empty dark panel.
findings.evidence: metrics imgs: 0; gradients: 1; hero section 479px tall, text-only.
findings.what: Zero images on the entire page (imgs: 0 in metrics at both widths). The hero is a flat dark slab with no photo, texture, or brand mark. For a carpentry business there is no visual proof of work anywhere.

findings.cause: Provenance badge rendered per-object with no aggregation or quieter treatment at grid density.
findings.evidence: viewport-services-scrolled.png; services-inventory.json shows the pill span in each article.
findings.location: Services grid (5 cards) + every content section
findings.what: Provenance pills ('WEBSITE STATEMENT' / 'SITE RECORD') repeat on every card and every section: 5 identical pills in the services grid plus per-section pills. Honest labeling, but visually noisy chrome that competes with the content.

findings.cause: One-size-fits-all section padding and single-column layout regardless of content volume.
findings.evidence: happy-place-1440.png sections 9, 4, 6; metrics textLen 265 / 53 / 31 against heights 367 / 248 / 210.
findings.location: Featured Object section (y~2749, 367px tall); 'Where we work' (248px); 'Find us' (210px)
findings.what: The Featured Object card (~300px wide) sits alone in a 976px-wide section with ~65% dead space to its right. 'Where we work' and 'Find us' are single-pill sections with full section padding for one line of content.

findings.cause: Composition applies the same section frame to every component with no rhythm variation.
findings.evidence: happy-place-1440.png full page; section classes alternate 'fyd-section mx-auto w-full max-w-5xl' on white/off-white.
findings.location: About through Find us (6 consecutive sections)
findings.what: Strict white / off-white band alternation, identical max-w-5xl containers, identical serif h2 style, identical pill badges. The page reads as a template loop rather than a designed sequence.

findings.evidenceItIsFine: Cards exist in the DOM with correct text, colors (#232033 on #FFFFFF), and 3-column grid layout (services-inventory.json). They are hidden by entrance motion, not missing. See VQ-001 for the real defect.
findings.suspicion: Service cards fail to render (blank 613px section).

findings.evidenceItIsFine: Not empty: it contains 'SITE RECORD' (forensics.json). The real defect is illegible contrast, filed as VQ-002.
findings.suspicion: The hero pill is empty (no text).

findings.evidenceItIsFine: documentElement.scrollWidth equals innerWidth at both widths; no overflow.
findings.suspicion: Horizontal overflow or breakage at either width.

findings.evidenceItIsFine: Both captures show the same structure, same 3-column services grid, same section order. No width-specific breakage.
findings.suspicion: Layout breaks or reflows badly between 1440 and 1280.

findings.what: Dark navy (#232033) hero slab + gold (#C9A227) accent + Playfair-like display serif + rounded pill badges matches the most common AI-generated site template look. Not a defect per se, but distinctiveness should be tracked across the 10/25/100 progression or every FYD site will look related.

The FYD site itself has no navigation; the only nav (Home/About/Services/Explore) belongs to the demo shell. Single-page is a legitimate choice, but anchor navigation to sections would help on a 3000px+ page.
CTA coverage is adequate (hero 'Visit website'/'Ask FYD' pair, repeated mid-page). No sticky or repeated contact CTA, acceptable for desktop.

The demo shell's customization panel is ~40% of the page height (2068 of 5272px). Any gate judging the full page judges mostly shell. The gate should evaluate the FYD site region only, or a shell-less route.
Shell header ('FYD SOCIAL / Generated site demo', 'Procedural clone proof' badge, nav) correctly labels the page as a demo. Fine as labeling; keep it out of site scoring.

summary.verdict: FAIL: ships with invisible-until-scroll content, an illegible hero badge, and zero media. Not gate-ready.
